Method We address the robustness problem on top of GE-FL BIBREF0 , a GE method which leverages labeled features as prior knowledge. A labeled feature is a strong indicator of a specific class and is manually provided to the classifier. For example, words like amazing, exciting can be labeled features for class positive in sentiment classification.
